title: Declare tp_r 3.5 as the predictive TP of the 1d pullback family (slv/ief/iaum alpaca_live+portfolio; gdx/tlt/gld paper), replacing the 50 R sentinel
note: Population: n=326 trades of the 1d pullback family, n=133 out-of-sample, window 2018-02-01 to 2026-10-15 (RQ-20261016-014). [2026-10-22 ~06:40Z OPERATOR DECISION, Thursday walk-through popup, relayed by manager session_01CSwhZWiw15rVCkjsJ8Cpuh] "Declare 3.5R (Recommended)". Executed by lane OPERATOR-DECISIONS-1022 (ief now paper-only after #19403). | [BACKLOG-DRAIN 2026-11-01] REOPEN: FAILED on n=1. order_packages latest 400: the only *_pullback_1d package created after 2026-10-22T09:55Z is gdx_pullback_1d 2026-10-28T19:35 (short, status rejected, paper): meta tp_r=3.5 but tp=74.855 vs entry 83.08 sl 88.707 = 1.46R (3.5R would be 63.4); exit_plan targets reach_r=1.4617. The declared 3.5R is not what the order carries. One sample, on a paper short; check whether a reach cap or short-side path rewrites the TP, and re-run on a long. 2026-11-04 BACKLOG-DRAIN-20261104: FAILED again, now on a long, and ROOT CAUSE found by arithmetic. Population: the 2 *_pullback_1d order_packages created after the 2026-10-22T09:55Z deploy (latest 400 packages). tlt_pullback_1d long 2026-11-04T14:49Z: meta tp_r 3.5, risk_per_unit 1.8125, tp 87.56875, sl 79.4125 => bracket anchored at signal price 81.225 (sl=entry-2.5ATR, tp=entry+3.5*1.8125); package entry is 82.95, so tp-from-entry / sl-from-entry = 1.305R. gdx short 10-28: anchored at ~85.62, entry 83.08, 1.46R. In both the declared 3.5R is measured from the SIGNAL price while the order fills at a different price, so the real bracket R from the fill is 1.3-1.5R, not 3.5R. Hypothesis (not yet traced in code): TP/SL are computed once at signal time and not re-anchored to the fill/entry the order carries. Next: trace where tp is set vs entry; Tier 3 fix (re-anchor or size from fill), file to the bracket lane. Owner manager. 2026-11-04 CORRECTION (same lane, after reading the package fields rather than inferring): the 'anchored at signal price vs fill' hypothesis above is WRONG. Read fields: tlt_pullback_1d package entry 81.225 sl 79.4125 tp 83.59 (=1.305R), but its own exit_plan.final.price is 87.56875 (=3.5R) and the signal builder (htf_pullback_trend_2h.py:361, min(entry*1.099, entry+tp_r*risk)) yields 87.57; gdx_pullback_1d short entry 83.08 sl 88.707 tp 74.855 (1.46R, 3.5R would be 63.4). The 9.9% venue cap does not explain it (TLT TP is 2.9% from entry). So the package TP is lowered AFTER the signal builder and AFTER the exit_plan is written, by something not yet identified (candidates: tp_revision at entry, a reach/realism clamp, an executor rewrite). Next: trace tp from signal -> intent -> order_packages for tlt_pullback_1d pkg (created 2026-11-04T14:49Z); Tier 3 fix. n=2 packages. [2026-11-04 lane TP-REALMONEY-UNITS] HELD-OUT PASS on the GLD twin: RQ-20261104-c6f1-06 (tp_extend X351: held-out 15.50 vs 14.70 R, n 14, low power; PR #22999). Tier-3 proposal with the manager: the same tp_extend block on iaum_pullback_1d and gld_pullback_1d. [2026-11-04 lane TP-REALMONEY-UNITS] Operator popup 2026-11-04 ~22:49Z (relayed by Manager Session 2026-11-04b): iaum_pullback_1d + gld_pullback_1d mirror (c6f1-06 PASS, n=14, low power): "Apply, flag low-n (Recommended)". Tier-3 declare PR follows once #22999 merges. [2026-11-04 lane TP-REALMONEY-UNITS] Declare PR (branch claude/tp-declare-xrp-iaum-20261104): tp_revision tp_extend on iaum_pullback_1d + gld_pullback_1d. LOW-N CAVEAT (operator 'flag low-n'): the evidence RQ-20261104-c6f1-06 is +0.80 R over only 14 held-out trades on the GLD twin (registered floor 12); a P&L-neutral compliance pass, not an edge claim. MONITOR: on each of the next closed iaum/gld pullback trades, read package meta (tp_revision present), whether a tp_extend amend fired (TRADE UPDATED tp_reason) and the close reason vs the static-3.5R counterfactual; a first extension that amends wrongly or fails to land is a revert trigger (delete the line).

observation.what: DECLARED + DEPLOYED: tp_r 3.5 (tp_intent r_multiple, basis RQ-20261016-014_pooled_kstar_3.5R) on slv/iaum/gdx/tlt/gld/ief_pullback_1d via #19479 (f8a9b6fd7, running 2026-10-22 09:55Z; /api/bot/config shows tp_r 3.5 on all six). OBSERVE: the next 1d pullback entry on any alpaca account carries a resting TP at entry + 3.5 R (journal order_packages tp vs entry/sl). TP doctrine: entry_tp FAIL 28 -> 16 routings (check_tp_doctrine.py); tp_revision still undeclared on these legs.
